title: Reduce a nitrile
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Hydride reduction converts a nitrile into a primary amine after workup. The nitrile carbon is retained as CH₂ bonded to NH₂ in ethylamine.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of acetonitrile under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Acetonitrile is treated with 1. LiAlH₄; 2. water. Which major organic product forms after workup? Hydride reduction converts a nitrile into a primary amine after workup. The nitrile carbon is retained as CH₂ bonded to NH₂ in ethylamine.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
